steps.en: Furnished driver details are stored, but nothing links them to classified vehicles
steps.id: Data driver yang di-furnish tersimpan, tapi tidak ada kaitannya dengan classified vehicle
steps.why_en: The general furnish feature stores driver details for all notices, with nothing specific to classified vehicles.
steps.why_id: Fitur furnish umum menyimpan data driver untuk semua notice, tanpa kekhususan classified vehicle.

steps.en: A daily job finds classified vehicle notices that have furnished driver details
steps.id: Job harian mencari notice classified vehicle yang punya data driver furnish
steps.why_en: No daily job combines classified vehicles with furnished driver details; the existing reports cover other things.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada job harian yang menggabungkan classified vehicle dengan data driver yang di-furnish; laporan yang ada mencakup hal lain.

steps.en: The report shows the furnished driver's details for those notices
steps.id: Laporan menampilkan data driver yang di-furnish untuk notice tersebut
steps.why_en: The only furnished-driver report covers a different vehicle group, so nothing lists driver details for classified vehicles.
steps.why_id: Satu-satunya laporan furnished driver mencakup kelompok kendaraan lain, jadi tidak ada yang memuat data driver classified vehicle.

steps.en: The report goes to the OIC dashboard for follow-up
steps.id: Laporan diteruskan ke dashboard OIC untuk ditindaklanjuti
steps.why_en: There is no dashboard content and no such report to send to officers.
steps.why_id: Dashboard tidak punya isi dan tidak ada laporan yang bisa dikirim ke petugas.
